translation:
(Shuqi (蜀漆) is its envoy (使); it is averse to dandan (狗膽), gansui (甘遂), and yuanhua (芫花).)

The original text of the Benjing: Haige (海蛤), bitter in flavor, neutral. It treats cough with rebellious qi (咳逆上氣), gasping and dyspnea with vexation and fullness (喘息煩滿), chest pain, and chills and fever.
